g.text: Points are the intercept of the paired-difference regression — the tumor rise at zero change in the covariate — with 95% CI. D1, 22-gene hepatocyte identity;
C1, 21-gene non-parenchymal content. Covariates, tests and decision rules were fixed before the data to test them were obtained; variance inflation was 1.12 and 1.14 in the
two paired cohorts, so the joint estimates are not collinear.
